::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Mar 5 1896  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book, Hampshire Record Office 70M92W/60/318
:::

Dear Madam
I have now insured all the property.  

The cottages for	1600

Your house		 800

,,      possessions	 200

Olford house	         300	

[Mrs Bishop](people/person_156.qmd)s	 ,,	 200

Broadway	,,	 300

[Hicks](people/person_689.qmd)		,,
& shop			 360=

			£3760

The premium will all come due at one time, at Ladyday.  The amount now due after making allowance on the old policies not yet expired is £4.7.0 for which please send a cheque, this stands from now till Ladyday 1897.  Then the regular annual premium will be £4.13.9 of which notice will be given as usual

I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](people/person_2094.qmd) esq

Miss Yonge

I have put the policy with the deeds
